mark start
warp DesertColossus_Adult DesertColossus_FromHountedWasteland adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A

press A

press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark llegada
wait 3000               # B loads after A (r03_pareja) or with it (run.ps1): wait for it
mark r01-cofres            # the Colossus' chests
place -3.00 101.10 0.00
wait 300
flag DesertColossus_IsSecretHole_TreasureBoxAppear 1
flag DesertColossus_Tbox_On 1
wait 600               # the other one sees us in this room
mark r02-puerta-templo     # at the Spirit Temple's door
place -159.30 97.20 10.30
wait 300
wait 600
mark salida             # into SpiritTemple
goto -173.70 10.00 0.8 900
wait 1800               # the scene change, then the other one lands too
mark fin
